751-3755-4885.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4247-7084-8232.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

586-728-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3560-5972-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3560-5972-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3560-5972-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2557-5658-6245-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
2557-5658-6245-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
2557-5658-6245-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1287-4918-6320-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-4918-6320-7824.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create two token copies of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

943-2203-2597-4235-5233.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-2203-2597-4235-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Boros Garrison.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Boros Garrison.
Repeat.

215-1376-1753.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-1753.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

206-215-1355.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
206-215-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7782.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2350-3532-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2350-3532-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1636-3918-5371-7629.description:
Activate Trazyn using Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-3918-5371-7629.notes: Since Trazyn will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

372-2974-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Daydream.
372-2974-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Daydream.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1379-2388-2963-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
1379-2388-2963-6587.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1558-2638-3478-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3478-4231-4321.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1409-2557-5422.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve the The Third Doctor trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-4676-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

147-1638-2060-3334.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Lae'zel.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-4284.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Clone.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Clone by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3664-5478-5701-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are two mana-producing land cards in your graveyard.
There are three or more card types among cards in your graveyard excluding the "Creature" type.
3664-5478-5701-5720-5721.description:
Play Lotus Field. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Lotus Field trigger, sacrificing it and Echoing Deeps.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
When Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field enter, they each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps, Lotus Field and two other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field triggers, sacrificing them and the lands tapped for mana in step 6.
Activate Shifting Woodland's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 5.

5411-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1496-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4484-4871-5643-5686-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

4068-6575-6685.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2034-4063-6625.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1350-2506-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning the nontoken Biovisionary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time, and then repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

678-3188-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-3188-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

813-1922-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Blur.
813-1922-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2452-3249-5670-6458--56.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2452-3249-5670-6458--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4094-5658-6245-6441.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4094-5658-6245-6441.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4094-5658-6245-6441.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
4094-5658-6245-6441.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

488-641-1492-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Tormod's Crypt or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1492-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2034-2523-5401.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bilbo, adding {C}{C}.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

2072-2781-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
2072-2781-4605.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

3101-4871-5258-5618-6131.notablePrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-4871-5258-5618-6131.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ignot Chewer for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ingot Chewer enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, destroying target artifact.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to sacrifice Ingot Chewer.
When Ingot Chewer dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Ingot Chewer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger from step 7, causing you to exile the top five cards of your library, including Ingot Chewer, with the ability to play those cards until end of turn.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ingot Chewer from exile for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Repeat from step 3.

224-1525-4862-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4862-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
If the sacrificed creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Omnath trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Omnath trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

2511-4053-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
2511-4053-5944.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.
2511-4053-5944.notes: If you wish to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Bloodflow Connoisseur, instead do not resolve its abilities, and then remove Solemnity from the battlefield. Then, resolve the abilities to get the +1/+1 counters.

719-1593-3809-4508-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1593-3809-4508-5299.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {2}.
Furnace Celebration triggers, causing you to pay {2} to deal two damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2060-3129-3490-3517-4868.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2060-3129-3490-3517-4868.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer, causing you to pay {2} to put four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers four times.
Resolve the first three Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1056-1719-4684.notablePrerequisites:
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
You have at least one additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
1056-1719-4684.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling cards from your graveyard equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Vizier of Tumbling Sands encore until end of turn.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' encore ability by paying {2}{U} and exiling it, causing you to create a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate a Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping a different Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat from step 3.

687-2034-2220.description:
Cast Deadly Grub by paying {2}{B}.
Deadly Grub enters the battlefield with three time counters and a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing the three time counters from Deadly Grub.
Deadly Grub's vanishing ability triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deadly Grub, adding {C}{C}.
Deadly Grub dies, creating a 6/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Deadly Grub trigger from step 4, doing nothing since Deadly Grub is no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 3, causing you to mill three cards and return Deadly Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

168-1624-3765.description:
Cast Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Oblivion Ring triggers, returning Near-Death Experience to the battlefield.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, winning you the game.

787-1124.notablePrerequisites:
Teferi has at least five loyalty counters on it.
You control a combination of up to three permanents on the battlefield with the ability to produce a total of at least {4}.
You control an additional permanent that can be tapped to add at least {U}.You have enough mana to recast Teferi from your command zone minus four.
787-1124.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing all planeswalkers you control to activate their loyalty abilities and additional time this turn.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping the Chain Veil and the three mana-producing permanents.
Repeat from step 1 until Teferi dies due to having zero loyalty.
Cast Teferi from your command zone.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by adding a loyalty counter to it, looking at the top two cards of your library and putting one card from the top of your library into your hand and the other onto the bottom of your library.
Do this x times, where x is equal to one half times the number of times you activated The Chain Veil this turn minus four, rounded down.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability, untapping the Chain Veil and the three mana-producing permanents.
Repeat step 7 an additional time.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by untapping the three mana producing permanents and the additional mana producing permanent, adding {4}{U}.
Repeat step 9 until Teferi dies due to having zero loyalty.
Repeat from step 4.
